gloss: scenic spot; place of natural beauty

definitions.gloss: scenic spot, place of natural beauty
definitions.explanation: A location known for its beautiful natural scenery. In Japan, certain places are officially designated as 名勝 by the government under the Cultural Properties Protection Act.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{渓谷|けいこく}→渓谷：10932_keikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名勝|めいしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This gorge is designated as a national scenic spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名勝|めいしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many beautiful places in Japan called scenic spots.

examples.japanese: {天橋立|あまのはしだて}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{三景|さんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧{名勝|めいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Amanohashidate is a scenic spot known as one of the Three Views of Japan, visited by many tourists every year.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday usage, {名勝|めいしょう} refers to any well-known scenic location. In official contexts, it refers to places designated by the Japanese government as culturally significant natural scenery under the {文化財保護法|ぶんかざいほごほう} (Cultural Properties Protection Act).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名勝|めいしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to designate as a scenic spot
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名勝|めいしょう}: nationally designated scenic spot
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}{記念物|きねんぶつ}→天然記念物：04899_tennenkinenbutsu⟧・{名勝|めいしょう}: natural monument and scenic spot
- {名勝|めいしょう}{旧跡|きゅうせき}: scenic spots and historic sites

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧ is a more general and casual term for any famous place or tourist attraction, while {名勝|めいしょう} specifically emphasizes natural beauty and carries a more formal, literary tone. ⟦{景勝地|けいしょうち}→景勝地：20387_keishouchi⟧ is another formal term for a place with outstanding scenery.
